official_measurement_examples.name: Current TPO collection
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data reported 107,674 TPO records from 74 providers with collector activity and new data on 24 July 2026; national coverage is not proof of complete local coverage.

official_measurement_examples.name: TPO legal instrument versus geometry
official_measurement_examples.fact: A TPO legal instrument, protected zone and individual-tree geometry are related but distinct records and must not be silently treated as one polygon.

official_measurement_examples.name: Conservation area notice
official_measurement_examples.fact: A tree in a conservation area without a TPO can still require a section 211 notice before specified works; no TPO does not mean no tree control.

official_measurement_examples.name: Felling licence current guidance
official_measurement_examples.fact: Forestry Commission felling guidance published 8 July 2026 requires a licence for growing trees unless an exemption applies and evidence must support any claimed exemption.

official_measurement_examples.name: TPO consent versus felling licence
official_measurement_examples.fact: TPO consent and Forestry Commission felling licensing are separate statutory controls; one must not be used as a proxy for the other.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning permission separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning permission does not automatically authorise protected-tree works or remove felling-licence requirements.

official_measurement_examples.name: Restocking conditions
official_measurement_examples.fact: A felling licence can include restocking and enforcement conditions that can bind later landowners; licence approval is not parcel development clearance.

official_measurement_examples.name: Dataset provenance limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data states some TPO data was created by MHCLG while authoritative-source replacement continues, so provenance and provider coverage must remain visible.

core_rules: TPO record is not complete national coverage proof
TPO legal instrument is distinct from tree or zone geometry
no TPO is not proof no conservation-area tree control exists
section 211 notice is distinct from TPO consent
felling licence is distinct from TPO consent
planning permission is not protected-tree consent
felling licence is not planning permission
restocking condition can survive ownership change
tree-protection data does not determine land ownership
tree status does not determine development yield
no parcel tree clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official Planning Data, Forestry Commission, GOV.UK and legislation.gov.uk sources checked on 2026-07-26. July 2026 TPO collection and felling guidance currentity retained with instrument/geometry, conservation-area, licence and planning separation; no parcel promotion.
